## Big idea

JWT = signed token the client sends each request. Server does not store session (stateless).

```text
Login → JWT
Request + Authorization: Bearer <token> → filter validates → SecurityContext
```

## Practice

Issue JWT on login; create filter that validates JWT; protect APIs.
